dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) v02 VIEW — Listed Building polygons layer 3
evidence_slice: Historic England Open Data Hub service item 767f279327a24845bf47dfe5eae9862b publishes layer 3 'Listed Building polygons' as esriGeometryPolygon with ListEntry, Name, Grade, ListDate, AmendDate, CaptureScale, area_ha, NGR, Easting and Northing fields. Historic England metadata states polygons are available for listed buildings listed or substantively amended since 4 April 2011 and that area_ha is populated only where a building footprint has been mapped. NHLE List Entry 1239561 identifies Nos. 161 and 163 Magdalen Road, Exeter, as a pair of early-C19 detached villas, Grade II, with most recent amendment on 19 July 2016. The selected exact-record layer-3 query for ListEntry 1239561 with returnGeometry=true could not be retrieved through the available web channel; therefore no record-level polygon coordinates were accepted or fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Official layer 3 is esriGeometryPolygon and Historic England metadata says area_ha is populated only where a building footprint has been mapped, but the exact ListEntry 1239561 query response was inaccessible; no polygon coordinates were accepted.
